verify_commands.command: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/mutation-testing-findings.md && python -c "import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('plugins/dso/docs/contracts/mutation-testing-findings.md').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if all(k in t for k in ['per_stack_results','aggregate_kill_rate','schema_version','passthrough']) else 1)"

python -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/workflows/mutation-testing.yml')); on=d.get(True,d.get('on')); pr=on['pull_request']; sys.exit(0 if set(pr['types'])=={'synchronize','opened'} and 'branches' not in pr and 'pull_request_target' not in on and 'push' not in on else 1)"
python -c "import sys; t=open('plugins/dso/workflows/mutation-testing.yml').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'SCOPE-SEALED' in t and '411b' in t else 1)"
